logline: 가난이 한 겹씩 벗겨 낸 자리에서, 한 여자가 처음으로 제 손에 돈을 쥔다.
destination: 왕서방 집 문턱 — 그녀가 밤마다 되돌아오게 되는 자리
protagonist: 칠성문 밖 빈민굴로 밀려난 젊은 여자
anchor: a young woman in a faded white hanbok jacket and dark skirt, hair gathered in a low bun
palette: dusty ochre earth, washed grey cotton, thin autumn light, cold blue dusk

beats.beat: 가난한 집 딸이 혼례 가마에 오른다.
beats.visual: a young woman stepping into a small covered palanquin outside a mud-walled house, villagers watching
beats.motion: the palanquin tilts as she boards, curtains swing, bearers shift their grip

beats.beat: 게으른 남편 탓에 살림이 한 칸씩 줄어든다.
beats.visual: a young woman carrying a bundle out of a bare room, a man lying idle on the floor behind her
beats.motion: she hoists the bundle, he rolls over, dust drifts through the empty room

beats.beat: 그녀는 성 밖 빈민굴 한 칸에 짐을 푼다.
beats.visual: a young woman setting a bundle down inside a cramped shack of mud and straw, gap-toothed roof above
beats.motion: the bundle drops, straw dust falls from the roof, her shoulders sag

beats.beat: 감자밭 고랑에서 그녀가 자루를 채워 나간다.
beats.visual: a young woman crouching low between potato furrows at dusk, filling a burlap sack from the soil
beats.motion: her hands work fast into the soil, the sack swells, leaves rustle nearby

beats.beat: 밭 주인이 어둠 속에서 그녀를 불러 세운다.
beats.visual: a broad man standing at the edge of a field with a lantern, a crouching woman caught in its light
beats.motion: the lantern swings toward her, her body freezes, moths cross the beam

beats.beat: 그녀는 손에 쥔 지폐를 보고 처음 웃는다.
beats.visual: a young woman looking down at folded banknotes in her palm outside a shack, faint smile forming
beats.motion: her fingers close over the notes, her mouth curves, wind lifts her hem

beats.beat: 그 문이 열리면 그녀는 무엇을 하게 될까?
beats.visual: a young woman facing a heavy wooden gate opening a crack, warm light falling on her still face
beats.motion: the gate opens a hand's width, light spills over her, her jaw sets

beats.visual: snow settling over an empty slum alley at night, one lit window far off behind mud walls
beats.motion: snow falls thickly and settles, the far window dims, wind moves the drifts

withheld: 왕서방이 새 색시를 들이는 날 그녀가 낫을 들고 찾아가 벌어지는 결말
